selection_rule: Lowest mean information loss among configurations passing every predeclared rule across all comparison seeds.
release_boundary: Aggregate selection is not patient-level release approval. The held-out seed and external disclosure-control gates remain required.
optimality_boundary: The selected configuration is the best observed eligible setting within this declared cluster interval, parameterization, seed set, and stochastic search budget. It is not a proof of a global optimum.
